case_number: CIVIL APPEAL Nos.521-522 OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP(C)Nos.14948-14949 of 2017)
summary: Release deed of spes successionis; Hindu Succession Act Class I heir rights; Transfer of Property Act Section 6; estoppel against pre-deceased son's children; Gulam Abbas case distinction; grandfather's self-acquired property; minor/appellant unborn during release; partition suit concerning A-Schedule property; High Court erroneous application of estoppel; trial court decree restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; trial court decree restored recognizing appellants' inheritance rights.
